description: Update one of your scheduled events without changing its id. Omitted fields stay unchanged; empty notes, prompts or recurrence clear them

advance.description: Advance trigger with minutes and recipient user or agent; zero minutes and empty recipient clears it. Agent preparation is read-only

prompt.description: New standing instruction; empty clears it

repeat.description: hourly, daily, weekly, monthly; empty makes it one-off

title.description: New title; omitted keeps the existing title

when.description: New future time as RFC3339 with timezone offset

name: events_update
title: Update events
